blurPreset.maskXml: docs/research/premiere/blur-preset-mask.xml: SubComponent VideoFilterComponent AE.ADBE AEMask2 «Mask2» instance «01» under the effect; Path = ParameterID 7 (binary layout in the file header), vertices in fractions of the frame, so one preset fits 1080p and 4K; Inverted = ParameterID 17, Feather 14, Opacity 15, Expansion 16.
